tag: 週五收盤：道瓊重挫逾 650 點，那指小跌
zh: 週五（10/23）美股收低：道瓊下跌 652.82 點、-1.23%，收 52,215.16；標普 500 下跌 0.52% 至 7,623.68；那斯達克下跌 0.21% 至 25,955.34；羅素 2000 下跌 0.29% 至 2,775.90。AI 股在前一天重摔後試圖反彈，但原油大漲與殖利率貼近 5% 讓道瓊承壓，是這週的壓軸賣壓。
en: US stocks closed lower on Friday Oct. 23: the Dow fell 652.82 points, or 1.23%, to 52,215.16; the S&P 500 lost 0.52% to 7,623.68; the Nasdaq Composite slipped 0.21% to 25,955.34; and the Russell 2000 dropped 0.29% to 2,775.90. AI shares tried to bounce after Thursday's rout, but a surge in crude and a 10-year yield near 5% weighed on the Dow in the last session of the week.

stocks.n: 標普 500 ETF，指數 -0.52%
那斯達克 100 ETF，綜合指數 -0.21%

tag: 布蘭特衝 117 美元，十年期殖利率貼近 5%
zh: 能源與利率是週五主線：WTI 上漲 3.97 美元（+3.99%）至 103.44 美元，布蘭特結算 116.72 美元，是 5 月以來高點，原因是市場擔心美國對伊朗再度升級軍事行動；十年期美債殖利率上升約 3.5 個基點至 4.988%；黃金下跌 1.24% 至約 4,010 美元，被油價與殖利率雙重壓制。這是資訊整理，原因是各家報導的推測，無法由價格確認。
en: Energy and rates led Friday: WTI rose $3.97, or 3.99%, to $103.44 and Brent settled at $116.72, the highest since May, as traders feared a fresh US escalation against Iran; the 10-year Treasury yield rose about 3.5 basis points to 4.988%; gold fell 1.24% to about $4,010, pressured by both oil and yields. This is information only; the cause is reporters' inference and cannot be confirmed from price action.

tag: 個股異動：AmEx 裁員、航空與電信走弱，資安反彈
zh: Yahoo 財經盤中整理：美國運通（AXP）因宣布裁減約 5% 員工，股價跌約 3%；聯合、達美、美國航空因燃油成本上升走弱；電信類股因馬斯克可能把星鏈（Starlink）延伸到手機服務的報導而下跌；Meta 在前一日重摔 7% 後再跌約 1%，並準備新增股份類別。反向的是資安股：SailPoint、Cloudflare、Palo Alto Networks 各漲逾 7%，原因是 Evercore ISI 的調查指出資安預算展望轉強；SpaceX 傳出洽談租用 8 萬座美國基地台空間，股價小漲。
en: Yahoo Finance's live coverage: American Express fell about 3% after announcing a cut of roughly 5% of its workforce; United, Delta and American Airlines weakened on higher fuel costs; telecom shares fell on reports that Elon Musk may extend Starlink into phone service; Meta slid another 1% after Thursday's 7% drop as it prepares a new share class. On the other side, cybersecurity stocks bounced: SailPoint, Cloudflare and Palo Alto Networks each rose more than 7% after an Evercore ISI survey pointed to stronger security budgets, and SpaceX edged up on reports it is in talks to lease space on 80,000 US cell sites.

tag: 盤勢結構：道瓊領跌，不再只是 AI 的故事
zh: 把週四與週五放在一起看：週四是那斯達克 -2.60%、道瓊持平；週五反過來，道瓊 -1.23%、那斯達克僅 -0.21%。同時間布蘭特到 117 美元、十年期殖利率 4.99%，密大消費者信心終值 48.0（預期 46.3），標普服務業 PMI 初值 57.9（預期 58.0）。這是我們的讀法：賣壓從 AI 估值轉到能源成本與利率，傷害面變寬；但道瓊仍是本週第三週上漲（Schaeffer's）。這是資訊整理，不是買賣訊號。
en: Reading Thursday and Friday together: Thursday was Nasdaq -2.60% with a flat Dow; Friday flipped, with the Dow -1.23% and the Nasdaq only -0.21%. Meanwhile Brent hit $117 and the 10-year yield reached 4.99%, with final University of Michigan sentiment at 48.0 (versus 46.3 expected) and flash services PMI at 57.9 (versus 58.0). Our reading: selling rotated from AI valuations toward energy costs and rates, so the damage is broadening, yet the Dow still posted a third straight weekly gain, per Schaeffer's. This is information, not a trading signal.

tag: 美國運通：獲利優於預期，營收不及並裁員 5%
zh: 美國運通第三季調整後每股盈餘 4.68 美元，優於預期；但營收 200.6 億美元低於市場預估，公司給出 2026 全年每股盈餘 17.60 至 17.90 美元的區間，並宣布裁減約 5% 員工。股價週五約下跌 3% 至 3.7%。這是一份「獲利靠成本控管、營收沒有驚喜」的報告，市場在意的是營收動能而不是 EPS。
en: American Express reported third-quarter adjusted EPS of $4.68, ahead of estimates, but revenue of $20.06 billion fell short of the Street. It guided 2026 EPS to $17.60 to $17.90 and said it will cut about 5% of its workforce. Shares fell roughly 3% to 3.7% on Friday. It is a profit-through-cost-control report without a revenue surprise, and the market is focusing on revenue momentum rather than EPS.

tag: Gentherm：合併後首季營收 4.05 億美元，庫藏股已動用
zh: Gentherm（THRM）週四公布合併 Modine Performance Technologies 後的第三季：營收 4.05 億美元，匯率中性年增 4.4%，2026 全年財測已納入新事業；淨槓桿約 0.4 倍，季末流動性 4.942 億美元。公司在交割後已買回 6,000 萬美元股票，新核准的 4 億美元庫藏股授權還剩約 3.4 億美元。這是雷達池追蹤中的合併案，報告裡第一次看到合併後的資產負債表。
en: Gentherm (THRM) reported its first quarter after combining with Modine Performance Technologies on Thursday: revenue of $405 million, up 4.4% ex-FX, with full-year 2026 guidance updated to include the new business; net leverage was about 0.4x and quarter-end liquidity $494.2 million. It repurchased $60 million of stock after closing, with about $340 million left on a new $400 million authorization. It is a merger tracked on our radar, and this is the first look at the combined balance sheet.

tag: 聯準會 10/28 決策：維持不動是共識，12 月升息才是焦點
zh: FOMC 將於 10 月 27、28 日開會，28 日下午 2 點公布決策。聯邦基金利率目前在 3.75% 至 4.00%（9 月升息，為 2023 年 7 月以來首次）；利率期貨顯示 10 月維持不動的機率約 90% 至 92%，12 月升息的定價各家不同（約 55% 到 85%）。FXStreet 指出，若鷹派持平後 PCE 與 GDP 又超預期，美元動能可能再起；主席華許（Kevin Warsh）的記者會是市場最看重的片段。
en: The FOMC meets Oct. 27 and 28, with the decision at 2 p.m. ET on the 28th. The fed funds range is 3.75% to 4.00% after a September hike, the first since July 2023; futures price roughly a 90% to 92% chance of a hold in October, while December hike odds vary by source (about 55% to 85%). FXStreet notes that a hawkish hold followed by hot PCE and GDP data could revive dollar momentum, and Chair Kevin Warsh's press conference is the key moment for markets.

stocks.n: 長天期美債 ETF，對利率路徑最敏感
美元指數 ETF，鷹派持平的受惠方向
短天期美債 ETF，反映 12 月升息定價

tag: 通膨壓力的拼圖：油價創高、消費者信心 48.0
zh: 密大消費者信心終值 48.0，高於預期的 46.3 但仍在歷史低檔；標普服務業 PMI 初值 57.9，與預期 58.0 幾乎一致，代表服務業仍擴張。同時布蘭特 116.72 美元、十年期殖利率 4.99%，市場同時面對成本上升與融資成本上升。這是我們的整理：能源推升的通膨預期，會讓 10/29 的 PCE 物價指數比平常更被放大檢視。
en: Final University of Michigan sentiment came in at 48.0 versus 46.3 expected, still historically low; flash S&P Global services PMI was 57.9 versus 58.0 expected, so services remain in expansion. Brent at $116.72 and a 10-year yield of 4.99% mean markets face rising costs and rising financing costs at once. Our synthesis: energy-driven inflation expectations will make the Oct. 29 PCE price index more closely scrutinized than usual.

tag: FOMC 會議紀要：年內再升息一次仍屬適當，時機未定
zh: 10 月 7 日公布的會議紀要顯示，多數官員認為今年內再升息一次可能適當，但時機未定。紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯與副主席傑佛遜強調要先看後續數據；達拉斯聯準銀行總裁洛根則主張至少再升息兩次。這張卡是政策背景：10/28 的決策不只看升不升，還要看聲明與記者會是否把 12 月升息寫成基本情境。
en: Minutes released Oct. 7 showed most officials saw another hike this year as likely appropriate, though timing is uncertain. New York Fed President Williams and Vice Chair Jefferson stressed assessing incoming data first, while Dallas Fed President Logan argues for at least two more quarter-point hikes. The takeaway is policy context: the Oct. 28 decision hinges less on hike versus hold than on whether the statement and press conference make a December hike the base case.

stocks.n: 長天期美債 ETF，對升息路徑敏感

tag: 資安股逆勢走強：預算調查成催化劑
zh: 週五資安類股在大盤走弱時逆勢上漲：SailPoint、Cloudflare、Palo Alto Networks 各漲超過 7%，Yahoo 財經引述 Evercore ISI 的調查，指出企業資安預算展望轉強。這張卡的重點是訊號來源：一份券商調查而非公司財報，單日反應可能過度，要看下週以後的財報與指引是否印證。
en: Cybersecurity shares rose against a weak market on Friday: SailPoint, Cloudflare and Palo Alto Networks each gained more than 7%, with Yahoo Finance citing an Evercore ISI survey that points to stronger enterprise security budgets. The key point is the signal source: a broker survey rather than company results, so the one-day reaction may be overdone and needs confirmation from upcoming earnings and guidance.

tag: 油價創高的兩面：能源受惠，航空承壓
zh: 布蘭特到 116.72 美元的同時，航空股明顯走弱：聯合、達美、美國航空因燃油成本上升下跌；能源類股則是這波行情的直接受惠板塊。油價對板塊的影響不是對稱的：航空的燃油成本佔營業成本比重高，油價每漲一段，獲利預期都要重算；能源股則要看價格能否維持，而不是只看單日。
en: With Brent at $116.72, airline shares weakened visibly: United, Delta and American fell on higher fuel costs, while energy stocks were the direct beneficiaries. Oil's effect is not symmetric: fuel is a large share of airline operating costs, so each leg up forces earnings estimates to be recalculated, while energy stocks depend on whether prices hold rather than on a single day.

tag: 電信與衛星：星鏈傳聞牽動電信與鐵塔
zh: 電信類股週五下跌，原因是報導稱馬斯克計畫把星鏈延伸到手機服務，可能自建基地台或購買現有空間；另有報導說 SpaceX 洽談租用約 8 萬座美國基地台空間。這張卡是題材觀察：兩則都是報導與傳聞，尚無最終協議，電信與鐵塔業者受到的實際衝擊要看合約條件。
en: Telecom shares fell Friday on reports that Elon Musk plans to extend Starlink into phone service, possibly by building towers or buying space on existing ones; separately, reports said SpaceX is in talks to lease space on about 80,000 US cell sites. This is a themes-watch card: both are reports and rumors with no final agreement, so the real impact on carriers and tower owners depends on contract terms.

tag: 兩日對照：羅素 2000 比那斯達克抗跌
zh: 羅素 2000 週四上漲 0.11% 至 2,784.03，週五下跌 0.29% 至 2,775.90，兩天累計約 -0.18%，同期那斯達克綜合指數跌了約 2.8%；Chartmill 指出週四平均個股其實收高。這代表小型股這次沒有被 AI 資本支出疑慮拖累，但週五它跟著大盤收低，也說明小型股不是避風港：利率與油價才是它的主要壓力來源。

Small caps were not dragged down by AI capex doubts this time, yet Friday's decline shows they are no safe haven: rates and oil are their main pressure points.

tag: 判讀知識：殖利率逼近 5%，小型股為什麼更敏感
zh: 小型股對利率更敏感有兩個結構原因：第一，羅素 2000 成分公司負債中浮動利率比重較高，十年期殖利率貼近 5% 時，利息費用會更快侵蝕獲利；第二，常見估計是約四成成分公司尚未獲利，估值靠遠期成長，折現率上升時被壓縮得更多。這是資訊整理，數字是常見估計，個別公司差異很大。
en: Small caps are more rate-sensitive for two structural reasons. First, Russell 2000 constituents tend to carry a higher share of floating-rate debt, so a 10-year yield near 5% erodes earnings faster through interest expense. Second, commonly cited estimates put about 40% of constituents as unprofitable, with valuations leaning on distant growth that gets compressed more when discount rates rise. This is information only; the figures are common estimates and companies vary widely.

stocks.n: 羅素 2000 ETF，對利率最敏感的廣泛代表
區域銀行 ETF，小型金融股的利率敏感度對照

The point is that ETF trades are mechanical flows and do not signal a fund manager's view on a stock.

tag: Gentherm（THRM）：合併完成，庫藏股開始動用
zh: 這家公司做什麼：溫控座椅等車用熱管理，10/1 完成與 Modine Performance Technologies 的合併。為什麼被忽視：合併剛完成、新事業與舊事業混在一起，分析師模型還在重做。什麼正在改變：第一份合併後財報顯示營收 4.05 億美元、淨槓桿約 0.4 倍，並已買回 6,000 萬美元股票，新授權 4 億美元還剩約 3.4 億美元（SEC 8-K）。風險與反方：整合執行、車市循環與新股東持股結構；財報只有一季，趨勢尚未確立。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: What it does: automotive thermal management such as heated and cooled seats, which completed its combination with Modine Performance Technologies on Oct. 1. Why neglected: the merger just closed and the two businesses are blended, so analyst models are still being rebuilt. What is changing: the first combined report shows revenue of $405 million, net leverage of about 0.4x and $60 million of shares already repurchased, with about $340 million left on a new $400 million authorization (SEC 8-K). Risks and counterpoints: integration execution, the auto cycle and the new shareholder base; it is only one quarter, so no trend yet. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

tag: Shore Bancshares（SHBI）：淨息差升到 3.78%，但撥備跳升
zh: 這家公司做什麼：馬里蘭州社區銀行控股公司。為什麼被忽視：市值小、覆蓋少。什麼正在改變：第三季淨息差升至 3.78%（第二季 3.70%、去年同期 3.41%），淨利息收入 5,510 萬美元；上一個驗證點是 3.70% 能否守住，答案是守住並提高（SEC 8-K）。風險與反方：扣除加速攤銷收益後淨息差只從 3.45% 到 3.50%，提升多來自一次性；信用損失撥備從 90 萬美元跳到 530 萬美元。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: What it does: a Maryland community bank holding company. Why neglected: small market cap and thin coverage. What is changing: third-quarter net interest margin rose to 3.78% (3.70% last quarter, 3.41% a year ago) with net interest income of $55.1 million; the prior checkpoint was whether 3.70% could hold, and it held and improved (SEC 8-K). Risks and counterpoints: excluding accelerated accretion, the margin only moved from 3.45% to 3.50%, so much of the lift is one-time, and the credit loss provision jumped from $0.9 million to $5.3 million. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

tag: OBOOK（OWLS）執行長公開市場買進
zh: OBOOK Holdings（OWLS）執行長 Chun Wang 於 10 月 19 日在公開市場買進 12,192 股，價格約 4.27 美元，市值約 3.76 億美元（GuruFocus 整理的 SEC 申報）。金額約 5.2 萬美元，不大，但屬於執行長自掏腰包買進，不是選擇權行使。判讀提醒：單筆買進不是群聚，要看是否有第二位以上的內部人跟進。
en: OBOOK Holdings (OWLS) CEO Chun Wang bought 12,192 shares in the open market on Oct. 19 at about $4.27, with a market cap near $376 million, per GuruFocus's summary of the SEC filing. At about $52,000 the amount is small, but it is the CEO paying with his own money rather than exercising options. Caution: a single purchase is not a cluster, so watch for second and third insiders joining.

stocks.n: OBOOK，執行長買進 12,192 股，約 4.27 美元

tag: Rapport Therapeutics（RAPP）董事買進約 10 萬美元
zh: OpenInsider 最新內部人買進清單顯示，Rapport Therapeutics（RAPP）董事 Paul M. Silva 於 10 月 22 日買進 3,680 股，價格 27.08 美元，約 10 萬美元。RAPP 是臨床階段生技，沒有營收，股價主要由試驗數據決定。判讀提醒：生技的內部人買進可能早於或晚於重大數據公布，單一董事的買進很難視為方向訊號。
en: OpenInsider's latest insider-buys list shows Rapport Therapeutics (RAPP) director Paul M. Silva bought 3,680 shares at $27.08 on Oct. 22, about $100,000. RAPP is a clinical-stage biotech with no revenue, so the stock is driven mainly by trial data. Caution: insider buying in biotech can come before or after major data, so one director's purchase is hard to read as a directional signal.

stocks.n: Rapport Therapeutics，董事買進 3,680 股，27.08 美元

tag: 判讀提醒：選擇權授予不是買進，賣出也有雜訊
zh: 同一週的申報裡有兩種容易讀錯的內容：Trade Desk 執行長 Jeff Green 10/21 申報的是取得 1,618,489 股選擇權，是薪酬授予，不是公開市場買進；Teradyne 董事 Marilyn Matz 以每股 350 美元賣出 400 股，金額小，個人賣出常出於稅務或資產配置。群聚買進的常見定義是約五天內三位以上不同內部人買進，同一人買三次只算一位。
en: Two easy-to-misread filings appeared in the same week: Trade Desk CEO Jeff Green's Oct. 21 filing shows an acquisition of 1,618,489 options, a compensation grant rather than an open-market purchase; Teradyne director Marilyn Matz sold 400 shares at $350, a small sale where individual selling often reflects tax or allocation needs. A common definition of a cluster buy is three or more different insiders within about five days; one person buying three times counts as one.

tag: 近 30 天申報：淨賣出為主，Boozman 買進思科

tag: 判讀卡：金額是區間，延遲最多 45 天
zh: 這週的 Boozman 思科申報剛好示範了政要資料的限制：同一筆交易，兩個來源給出不同的金額區間，因為申報只有寬區間、沒有確切金額。STOCK Act 允許最多 45 天延遲，所以 9 月 24 日的交易到 10 月才看到；許多申報來自配偶或信託帳戶；跟單者實際買到的是別人 45 天前的價位。這個頻道只記錄誰申報了什麼，不暗示動機，也不是跟單建議。
en: This week's Boozman-Cisco filing neatly shows the limits of congressional data: two sources give different dollar ranges for the same trade because filings carry only broad ranges, not exact amounts. The STOCK Act allows up to a 45-day delay, so a Sept. 24 trade surfaces in October; many filings reflect spouse or trust accounts; and anyone copying trades buys at prices set 45 days earlier. This channel records only who filed what, implies no motive, and is not copy-trading advice.

stocks.n: 思科，同一筆交易兩個來源金額區間不同的例子

en: Tue Oct. 27: durable goods orders, Case-Shiller home prices, new home sales, consumer confidence; the two-day FOMC meeting begins. Wed Oct. 28: advance goods trade balance, wholesale and retail inventories, and the Fed decision at 2 p.m. ET. Thu Oct. 29: advance Q3 GDP, jobless claims, September personal income and spending, and the PCE price index including core. Fri Oct. 30: employment cost index and Chicago PMI. Dates are tentative; follow official releases (Schaeffer's).

tag: 本週最值得記住的一件事：成本全部同時上升
zh: 把這週放在一起：Meta 把 2026 資本支出下限拉到 1,350 億美元、布蘭特 116.72 美元、十年期殖利率 4.99%、聯準會在 9 月升息後 12 月可能再升。AI 投資、能源、融資三種成本同時上升，市場在週四用那斯達克、週五用道瓊表現出來。下週微軟與 Alphabet 要在聯準會決策日當天交資本支出答案，這是本週最值得盯的事。這是資訊整理，不是買賣訊號。
en: Putting the week together: Meta lifted the floor of its 2026 capex to $135 billion, Brent hit $116.72, the 10-year yield reached 4.99%, and the Fed hiked in September with December possible. AI investment, energy and financing costs all rose at once, and markets showed it through the Nasdaq on Thursday and the Dow on Friday. Next week Microsoft and Alphabet must answer on capex on the same day as the Fed decision, which is the thing to watch. This is information, not a trading signal.
